info.name: Public Records APIs (Apify)
info.description:
Importable Postman Collection v2.1 for 17 Public Records Actors (Skool omitted). Each request bills through the caller's own Apify account. Set the collection variable APIFY_TOKEN locally — this file ships with it empty and contains no secrets.

Import: Postman → Import → this file. OpenAPI specs: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Publicrecords/apify-actor-openapi

Author: Public Records.

variable.description: Set locally. Never commit a real token.

item.name: Ashby Jobs Scraper — New Job Postings Since Any Date
item.description:
Scrape Ashby jobs and job postings from any Ashby job board, only those published since a date or window (24h, 7d, 30d). Title, location, department, compensation, URL, description. Pay per result.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/ashby-jobs-scraper
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/ashby-jobs-scraper
Author: Public Records.

item.name: Start a run of publicrecords/ashby-jobs-scraper

request.description:
Starts the Actor asynchronously. Poll the returned run, then read dataset items. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/ashby-jobs-scraper

Runs on the importer's own Apify account (pay-per-use). Set APIFY_TOKEN locally; this collection ships with it empty.

item.name: Run publicrecords/ashby-jobs-scraper and return dataset items

request.description:
Synchronous convenience endpoint. Waits for the run to finish and returns dataset items.

Runs on the importer's own Apify account (pay-per-use). Set APIFY_TOKEN locally; this collection ships with it empty.

item.name: Calibration Ledger — trust a forecast, with evidence (beta)
item.description:
Given a claim from an organization (IMF, OECD, Fed/FOMC, SPF, ECB SPF, or a listed issuer), returns that organization's track record: error distribution, intervals, bias, band coverage, worst misses with source links — or honest 'no coverage' (free). Organizations only, never people.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/calibration-ledger
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/calibration-ledger
Author: Public Records.

item.name: Company Website to LinkedIn & Social Media Links
item.description:
Which social profiles belong to this company? Resolves a name, website or Google Maps listing to its LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook handles, with evidence. Instagram and Facebook are returned from the site on the default path, not platform-verified.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder

item.name: Etsy Scraper — Listings, Prices, Best Sellers & Ad Flags
item.description:
Etsy scraper for product research: search results by keyword, market page or category URL with price, rating, reviews, Bestseller and Star Seller badges, ad flag, shop and Etsy's rank position. One row per listing. Pay per listing row. Works with Claude.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper
Author: Public Records.

item.name: Start a run of publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper

request.description:
Starts the Actor asynchronously. Poll the returned run, then read dataset items. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper

Runs on the importer's own Apify account (pay-per-use). Set APIFY_TOKEN locally; this collection ships with it empty.

body.raw:
{
  "sort": "relevance",
  "maxPages": 5,
  "maxItems": 20,
  "maxCacheAgeHours": 24,
  "fillLazyCards": true,
  "is_best_seller": false,
  "is_star_seller": false,
  "free_shipping": false,
  "is_discounted": false,
  "instant_download": false,
  "is_handmade_only": false,
  "is_personalizable": false,
  "source": "",
  "proxyConfiguration": {
    "useApifyProxy": true,
    "apifyProxyGroups": [
      "RESIDENTIAL"
    ],
    "apifyProxyCountry": "US"
  }
}
